tables.title: Brand clients and how full their calendar is
tables.hint: One row for each brand: package posts and the calendar posts you plan each week; posts planned, posts waiting for approval, the next post and the calendar health fill in from the calendar.

tables.title: Team capacity by member and month
tables.hint: One row for each team member and month with the hours available for content; the posts they own that month, the hours needed and the load come from the calendar.

tables.title: Content pillars and target mix for every client
tables.hint: One row for each pillar of a client with the target share of posts; the posts planned, the real share and the difference from your target come out of the calendar.

tables.title: Monthly themes and campaigns by client
tables.hint: One row for each client and month: the theme, goal, lead pillar and the number of posts you promise; the posts planned and the coverage come from the calendar.

Plan every post on Content Calendar: date, brand, platform, format, pillar, topic, status and owner. The weekday and a flag for posts at risk or missed come out by themselves.
Check Calendar Gaps each week. It counts the posts planned against the posts you need and shows the weeks that are short, so you can fill them before they arrive.
Use Monthly Themes for the theme, goal and posts you promise each client, and Posting Frequency for posts a week on each platform. Both are checked against the calendar.
List holidays and awareness days on Key Dates and the busy and quiet seasons of each industry on Seasonal Peaks. They tell you when to start preparing and how many posts to add.
Keep ideas on Ideas Bank with a score from 1 to 5 for reach, fit and effort. Plan the top ideas first, and reuse captions, hashtag sets and evergreen posts from their own sheets.
Plan recurring formats on Recurring Series and cut one video into many posts on Repurposing Plan. The sheet counts the pieces, the hours saved and the weeks of content.
Write each campaign on Campaign Briefs and each launch on Product Launches. Link posts to a campaign in the calendar and the budget per post fills in.
Record audiences on Audience Personas, tone on Brand Voice and the best hours on Best Times, so every post is written for the right person at the right time.
Watch Team Capacity to see the hours each month needs for each person before you promise more work.

Use the 14 calculators for posts needed, content mix, frequency, campaign timeline, repurposing, idea scores, budgets, theme coverage, gaps, hashtags, reach goals, posting times, approval lead time and captions.
Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 9 step-by-step checklists and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Strategy Dashboard and Charts every week: posts planned, missed and at risk, gaps ahead, key dates to prepare and ideas waiting.

listing.title: Social Media Management Content Calendar and Strategy Excel Template: Pillars, Posts, Campaigns, Launches, Key Dates
listing.headline: Content calendar and strategy for every brand you manage in one file
listing.description:
Plan the social media of every brand you manage in one Excel workbook. Content Calendar holds every planned post for the year with date, platform, format, pillar, topic, status and owner, and a flag shows which posts are done, at risk or missed.

Content Pillars sets target shares for each client and compares them with the real mix. Calendar Gaps counts the posts needed, planned and missing for every client and week. Monthly Themes, Posting Frequency and Seasonal Peaks tell you how many posts each month and platform needs, and Key Dates lists holidays and awareness days by country with the day to start preparing.

Ideas Bank scores reach, fit and effort so the best ideas come first. Captions Bank, Hashtag Sets and Evergreen Library keep reusable content with checks for overused captions and hashtag sets that are too short or too long. Repurposing Plan turns one video into many posts and counts the hours saved. Campaign Briefs show the budget for each post and day, Product Launches count teaser posts, and Team Capacity turns the calendar into hours for each person.

14 calculators cover posts needed, content mix, frequency, campaign timeline, repurposing, idea scores, budgets, theme coverage, gaps, hashtags, reach goals, posting times, approval lead time and captions. Print 10 sheets and 10 letters, follow 9 checklists and send 29 WhatsApp messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part two of the Social Media Management suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for 30 brands to explore first. It helps you plan your work and does not promise results.

fa.Plan every post on Content Calendar: dat: برای هر پست در تقویم محتوایی برنامه ریزی کنید: تاریخ، نام تجاری، پلت فرم، قالب، ستون، موضوع، وضعیت و مالک. روز هفته و یک پرچم برای پست های در معرض خطر یا از دست رفته خود به خود بیرون می آیند.

fa.Use Monthly Themes for the theme, goal a: از تم های ماهانه برای موضوع، هدف و پست‌هایی که به هر مشتری قول می‌دهید، و از فرکانس انتشار برای پست‌های هفته‌ای در هر پلتفرم استفاده کنید. هر دو بر اساس تقویم بررسی می شوند.

Önce en iyi fikirleri planlayın ve kendi sayfalarındaki başlıkları, hashtag setlerini ve her zaman güncel kalan sosyal gönderileri yeniden kullanın.
